# Versus Courts

> Versus Courts is a sports court discovery, open play queue matchmaking, and venue booking platform in the Philippines for basketball, badminton, pickleball, tennis, and padel.

## Core Pages

- [Versus Courts Home](https://versuscourts.com/): Discover verified sports venues, find open play queues, tournaments, and sports communities.
- [Venues & Court Discovery](https://versuscourts.com/venues): Search verified sports venues by sport, location, amenities, price, and live availability.
- [Open Play Queues](https://versuscourts.com/queues): Browse upcoming open-play game queues and join matches matching your skill level.
- [Sports Events & Tournaments](https://versuscourts.com/events): Community tournaments, leagues, live match scoring, brackets, and standings.
- [Clubs & Communities](https://versuscourts.com/clubs): Meet local sports clubs, teams, and active player groups.
- [How It Works](https://versuscourts.com/how-it-works): Player guide to finding courts, joining queues, and playing together.

## Mobile Application

- [iOS App on Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ph/app/versus-courts/id6782629486): Download the official Versus Courts app for iOS.

## Legal & Support

- [Privacy Policy](https://versuscourts.com/privacy): Details on data protection, account privacy, and security practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://versuscourts.com/terms): User agreement and platform rules for players and venue operators.
- [Security](https://versuscourts.com/security): Security standards, authentication, and encryption protocols.
- [Support](https://versuscourts.com/support): Help center and venue partner support.
